body: R59 99518cf: body_state is version 2. body_state.injuries holds at most one named injury per region (Q2's shape, from Injury.build); body_state.injury_log is the newest-first list of finished ones. get_body_read() region rows now carry "injury" ({} when the region is only sore), and the "hold" block carries "injury" plus region_known: true when a stored injury names the region - the fight_history derivation stays as the fallback. medical_hold_until_week is still the ONE clock; medical_hold_reason is now the diagnosis's type_id. Q3 35bcdfd: InjuryWords.gd is live - type_label, region_label, severity_word, headline, date_line(injury, train/compete/hold), date_lines, clearance_words and lines(injury) give U9 every string it needs. Take the words from there rather than concatenating your own: a DIRECT week is stated flat (CLEARED TO TRAIN / CLEARED TO FIGHT WEEK n), an AUTHORED one is attributed (THE GYM ESTIMATES ...), an UNKNOWN one or a week of 0 is NO DATE SET. Full suite green on both.
topic: R59 and Q3 landed - U9 is unblocked
